THE AI BUILDER'S TOOLBOX
What to reach for, by the thing you're actually trying to do.

159 curated skills, repos and tools across 19 domains.
Every link checked 2026-08-13.

Things I built and actually run. All open source.

shadcn/ui — The component library most agent-generated React lands on. Know it.

shadcn/improve — Use your best model to audit the codebase, then let a cheap model execute the plan.

Tailwind CSS — Assume every agent already knows it. Fight this and you'll lose.
https://tailwindcss.com

oil-oil/oil-motion — Smooth, responsive web animations without hand-rolling easing curves.

https://figma.com

CLI & TERMINAL
Agents are best at things that have a command line. This is how you give them one.

HKUDS/CLI-Anything — Makes any software agent-native by giving it a CLI. The big idea on this whole page.
https://github.com/HKUDS/CLI-Anything

jackwener/OpenCLI — Turns any website into a CLI, using your already-logged-in browser.
https://github.com/jackwener/OpenCLI

googleworkspace/cli — One command for Drive, Gmail, Calendar, Sheets and Docs. Official.
https://github.com/googleworkspace/cli

iOfficeAI/OfficeCLI — Office suite built so agents can read and edit documents directly.
https://github.com/iOfficeAI/OfficeCLI

herdrdev/herdr — A runtime for your coding agents to actually live on.
https://github.com/herdrdev/herdr

cli/cli — GitHub's own CLI. PRs, issues, releases, Actions — all scriptable by an agent.
https://github.com/cli/cli

anthropics/anthropic-cli — Official CLI for the Claude API. Handy for quick scripted calls.
https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-cli

junegunn/fzf — Fuzzy finder. Rewires how you use a terminal within a day.
https://github.com/junegunn/fzf

BurntSushi/ripgrep — The fast grep. Already what your agent reaches for under the hood.
https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep

jesseduffield/lazygit — Git you can actually see. Best way to review what an agent just committed.
https://github.com/jesseduffield/lazygit

sharkdp/bat — cat with syntax highlighting and line numbers.
https://github.com/sharkdp/bat

yt-dlp/yt-dlp — Downloads audio and video from nearly anywhere. Backbone of most video pipelines.
https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp

─────────────────────────────
CONTEXT & TOKEN MANAGEMENT
The single biggest lever on cost and on whether long sessions stay coherent.

JuliusBrussee/caveman — "Why use many token when few token do trick." Cuts roughly 65% of tokens.
https://github.com/JuliusBrussee/caveman

DietrichGebert/ponytail — Makes the agent think like the laziest senior dev alive. Best code is the code you don't write.
https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail

Mibayy/token-savior — MCP server that held 97.9% on a real coding benchmark at 80% fewer active tokens.
https://github.com/Mibayy/token-savior

thomaschill/unclog — Audits which MCP servers, skills and CLAUDE.md bloat are eating your context window.
https://github.com/thomaschill/unclog

DeusData/codebase-memory-mcp — Indexes a codebase into a persistent knowledge graph so the agent stops re-reading everything.
https://github.com/DeusData/codebase-memory-mcp

MemPalace/mempalace — Best-benchmarked open-source memory system, and free.
https://github.com/MemPalace/mempalace

TencentCloud/TencentDB-Agent-Memory — Team-level shared memory hub rather than per-developer memory.
https://github.com/TencentCloud/TencentDB-Agent-Memory

Graphify-Labs/graphify — Turns a codebase plus its docs, schemas and PDFs into a queryable knowledge graph.
https://github.com/Graphify-Labs/graphify

vitali87/code-graph-rag — RAG aimed squarely at multi-language monorepos.
https://github.com/vitali87/code-graph-rag

tirth8205/code-review-graph — Local-first persistent map of your codebase, exposed over MCP and CLI.
https://github.com/tirth8205/code-review-graph

langchain-ai/openwiki — Writes and then maintains agent-facing docs for your repo.
https://github.com/langchain-ai/openwiki

pgvector/pgvector — Vectors inside Postgres. Usually the right answer before you buy a vector DB.
https://github.com/pgvector/pgvector

Chroma — Easiest local vector store to get running in an afternoon.
https://trychroma.com

NotebookLM — Best free tool for interrogating a pile of sources you didn't write.

pjeby/hot-reload — Auto-reloads Obsidian plugins while you build them. Tiny, essential.

DEPLOYMENT & INFRASTRUCTURE
Getting it off your laptop.

Vercel — Fastest path to a live frontend. The CLI is fully agent-drivable.
https://vercel.com

Railway — Where I put things that need a real backend and a database.
https://railway.com

Supabase — Postgres, auth, storage and vectors. Usually the whole backend.
https://supabase.com

supabase/supabase — Self-host it if you'd rather not rent it.
https://github.com/supabase/supabase

Netlify — The other obvious static/edge host.
https://netlify.com

Fly.io — Containers close to your users, without a Kubernetes hobby.
https://fly.io

Docker — Still the unit of "works on my machine" being false.
https://docker.com

apple/container — Linux containers on Apple silicon via lightweight VMs. Fast.
https://github.com/apple/container

anthropic-experimental/sandbox-runtime — Filesystem and network limits on agent-run code. Read this before you go autonomous.
https://github.com/anthropic-experimental/sandbox-runtime

anthropics/claude-code-action — Runs Claude Code inside GitHub Actions.
https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code-action

Send these to someone who just installed Claude Code and is staring at a blinking cursor.

EDITORS & HARNESSES
Where you sit while the agent works.

Cursor — The IDE most people arrive from. Still excellent at inline edits.
https://cursor.com

Zed — Very fast, collaborative, increasingly agent-native.
https://zed.dev

openai/codex — OpenAI's terminal agent. Best used as a second opinion on Claude's work.

xai-org/grok-build — xAI's harness and TUI. Fullscreen, mouse-interactive, extensible.

Warp — Terminal with agent features baked in rather than bolted on.
https://warp.dev


─────────────────────────────
MODELS, ROUTING & COST
Picking the right model and not overpaying for it.

OpenRouter — One API key, most models. Easiest way to A/B a model without a new account.
https://openrouter.ai

Artificial Analysis — Independent speed, cost and quality benchmarks. Check before believing a launch post.
https://artificialanalysis.ai

LLM-Stats — Fast side-by-side of price and context window.
https://llm-stats.com

diegosouzapw/OmniRoute — MIT-licensed gateway: 330+ providers, 1200+ models, many free.
https://github.com/diegosouzapw/OmniRoute

musistudio/claude-code-router — One local control plane to route Claude Code across different models.
https://github.com/musistudio/claude-code-router

BerriAI/litellm — The proxy layer most production stacks end up using.
https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm

AlexsJones/llmfit — One command tells you which models your actual hardware can run.
https://github.com/AlexsJones/llmfit

Ollama — Local models with the least ceremony.
https://ollama.com

LM Studio — Ollama with a GUI. Better for people who don't live in a terminal.
https://lmstudio.ai

JustVugg/colibri — Runs frontier MoE models on hardware you already own. Pure C, zero deps.
https://github.com/JustVugg/colibri
